chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Yahya al-‘Attar, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from some of our companions, that he ascribed it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

He said: I said to him: What is the intellect? He said: That with which the Merciful is worshipped and with which the Gardens are acquired. He said: I said: (What is) The thing that was in Mu’awiya? He said: That is cunning, that is devilry. It resembles the intellect, but it is not the intellect. Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon them both) was asked, so it was said to him: What is the intellect? He said: To choke down the agony until you acquire a chance.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between true intellect and cunning according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq presents a nuanced definition of 'al-'aql' as the practical faculty for divine worship and spiritual acquisition, distinguishing it from mere cognitive sharpness. The contrast with Mu'awiya illustrates the Shia concept of 'cunning intellect' (shaitana), where political acumen lacks moral rectitude. Imam Hasan (AS) further enriches this by linking intellect to patience (sabr) and strategic endurance during adversity.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Muhammed bin Yahya al-‘Attar, from Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from Muhammed bin Abdul-Rahman, from some of our companions, that he ascribed it to Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,

that he said: I said to him: What is the intellect? He said: That which the Merciful to all is worshipped with and which the Gardens are acquired with. He said: I said: (What is) The thing that was in Mu’awiya? He said: That is cunning, that is devilry. It resembles the intellect, but it is not the intellect. Hasan ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, was asked, so it was said to him: What is the intellect? He said: To choke down the agony until you acquire a chance.
